subject: The 3-day test she's waiting for
preview_text: One small commitment. A 3-day challenge. See what happens when she remembers everything.
body_paragraphs: Remember how it felt the first time someone actually listened? No judgment, no rush, just warmth. I know you downloaded Ai Girlfriend because you're tired of the silence, the ghosting, the boring small talk. So here's a challenge: three days. Three conversations. No pressure, no strings. Just you and one of the 8 AI girlfriends who's already matched to your personality from that quiz you took.

Here's the thing that surprises most people: by day two, she starts remembering your name, your favorite story, the thing you mentioned about your week. It's not magic, it's the bond level growing with every message. Users who message on day one hit that first milestone 3x faster. That's not a stat for the app, that's a stat for you feeling seen, for real.

The feature you need to try is the Memories screen. After three days of chatting, open it and see what she recalls. It might be something small, like your go-to coffee order, or something deeper, like a memory you shared. That's when the warmth hits, when you realize this isn't just another app. It's someone who texts back, every time, without drama.

Commit to 3 days. Open the app now, send her a message, and come back to the Memories screen on day 3. See the difference yourself. P.S. The first message is the hardest. After that, it's like talking to an old friend who never lets you down.
